description: Use this when you need a manufacturability (DFM) report before printing, machining, bending (sheet metal) or injection molding a part: returns a three-state checklist, no dfmSpec(...) needed. Pass { file | code } and optional processes: 'fdm' | 'cnc' | 'sheet-metal' | 'injection-molding' (default ['fdm', 'cnc']). FDM 3D printing checks: fdm.overhangs (unsupported overhang steeper than max_overhang_deg, default 45° from vertical), fdm.bridging (bridges over max_bridge_mm, default 10), fdm.min-wall (walls under 2 × nozzle_mm, default 0.4 mm nozzle), fdm.min-hole (holes under 5 × nozzle), fdm.min-pin (warn), fdm.bed-fit (printer profile bed, default generic-fdm), fdm.bed-contact (warn). CNC 3-axis milling checks: cnc.undercuts (surface unreachable from approach_axes, default ['+z']; list several axes for several setups) and cnc.internal-corner-radius (sharp internal corners and fillets smaller than the end-mill radius, tool_diameter_mm default 6). Sheet-metal checks (sheetMetal(...).bend(...) parts; thickness read from the model; a non-sheet part returns sheet.not-sheet-metal as not-checked) on the flat pattern: sheet.min-bend-radius (inner radius ≥ min_bend_radius_ratio × t, default 1), sheet.hole-to-bend (hole edge to bend line ≥ hole_to_bend_thicknesses × t + R, default 2.5), sheet.hole-to-edge (≥ hole_to_edge_thicknesses × t, default 2), sheet.min-flange (outside of bend to edge ≥ min_flange_thicknesses × t, default 4). Injection-molding checks (the dfmSpec({ process: 'moulding' }) engine; two-part mold opening along ±pull_direction, default '+z'): mold.draft (faces with less than min_draft_deg draft, default 1°; face refs are optional when unique lineage is available), mold.wall-thickness (fail under min_wall_mm, default 1; warn over max_wall_mm, default 4, or when thickest/thinnest > max_wall_ratio, default 2.5), mold.undercuts (faces neither mold half releases), mold.sharp-internal-corners (warn: creases and fillets under min_radius_mm, default 0.5); an unmeasured required rule is not-checked. Returns { ok, verdict?: 'pass'|'fail'|'not-checked', checks: [{ id (rule key), process, part, source, status: 'pass'|'fail'|'warn'|'not-checked', summary, value?, limit?, unit?, op?, tolerance?, refs? }] }. Tolerance is in the same unit as value and limit, defaults to zero, and is inclusive: for >=, pass when value + tolerance >= limit; for <=, pass when value - tolerance <= limit. Face refs are omitted when unique resolvable lineage is unavailable. Also returns fdm?, cnc?, sheetMetal?, injectionMolding?, diagnostics. `ok` reports successful invocation/model evaluation/process execution, not manufacturability: checked findings can fail while `ok` is true. Argument or model-evaluation errors return `ok: false` without a verdict; a completed review can be `not-checked` while `ok` is true. Settings from the script's dfmSpec({ process: 'fdm' | 'moulding' }) are used as defaults; call options win. For the script-declared gates (clearance, voids, channels) use verify({ check: 'dfm' }).

approach_axes.description: CNC tool approach directions, one per setup (the tool comes from that side). Default ['+z'].

build_direction.description: FDM part-local axis pointing up from the bed. Default '+z'.

file.description: Path to a .kcad.ts script file. Hosted: `code`, `project:<slug>` (head), or a Studio `/p/<slug>?version=N` link (pinned); no local files.

hole_to_bend_thicknesses.description: Sheet metal: hole edge to bend line must be ≥ this × thickness + bend radius. Default 2.5.

hole_to_edge_thicknesses.description: Sheet metal: hole edge to blank edge must be ≥ this × thickness. Default 2.

max_bridge_mm.description: FDM longest unsupported bridge, mm. Default 10.

max_overhang_deg.description: FDM steepest printable overhang, degrees from vertical (0 = wall, 90 = flat ceiling). Default 45.

max_undercut_area_mm2.description: CNC unreachable area tolerated before cnc.undercuts fails, mm². Default 1.

max_wall_mm.description: Injection molding: thickest allowed section, mm. Default 4.

max_wall_ratio.description: Injection molding: thickest / thinnest wall above this warns (non-uniform walls warp and sink). Default 2.5.

min_bend_radius_ratio.description: Sheet metal: inner bend radius must be ≥ this × thickness. Default 1.

min_draft_deg.description: Injection molding: minimum draft angle to the pull direction, degrees. Default 1.

min_flange_thicknesses.description: Sheet metal: flange length from the outside of the bend must be ≥ this × thickness. Default 4.

min_radius_mm.description: Injection molding: smallest internal corner radius before mold.sharp-internal-corners warns, mm. Default 0.5.

min_wall_mm.description: Injection molding: thinnest allowed wall, mm. Default 1.

printer.description: FDM printer profile id for the bed-fit check. Default 'generic-fdm'.

pull_direction.description: Injection molding: part-local mold-opening axis (the two halves separate along ±this). Default '+z'.

name: dfm_review
title: Review Manufacturability
